description: Find commercial parcels by situs address. Matches whole words of the street line (the part before the first comma), normalized: 'Street' = 'St', 'Northwest' = 'N.W.' = 'NW'; a suite, unit, '#' or floor is ignored. Give a house number ('1200 Main', '1200 Main St NW') or a street name with its type ('Main St'); a city or a part of a word alone matches nothing. After the first comma, give the city, state and ZIP code ('1200 Main St, Houston, TX 77002'): a state (two letters or the full name) named after a city keeps the answer to that state, before the limit is applied; the ZIP code and the city only order the matches (same ZIP code first, then same city, then the rest) and never filter; a bare state with no city, and suite, floor or box text, are ignored. No match returns coverage: what this registry holds, in the named state when there is one. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

query.description: Street address ('1200 Main St, Houston, TX 77002'), or a house number and street words, or a street name with its type; the city, state and ZIP code after the first comma narrow and order the matches.
